timing: POST-HOC: written after the registered outcomes were computed and inspected (out/report.txt run 1).
reason: Registered primary 'lean right' (lean net R > other net R, strict) counts ties as wrong. For the 'plan' target ties are structural: a stop resolves at exactly -1 R and a managed breakeven stop at exactly 0 R, so both sides often realize the same net R. Run 1 showed every side rule (lean, always-long, supertrend) far below 50% on plan cells (down to 7-15% on M1 plan), which measures the tie share and not side skill.
change: Add metrics tie (|net_long - net_short| < 1e-9) and st_tie; report tie share and the decisive hit rate = lean right / (bars - ties), with the same buckets, baselines (decisive), bootstrap, greying rule and monotonicity check. The registered primary is still reported unchanged. 'up' cells have no ties, so both metrics coincide there.
